visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, shoulder-length hair, wearing a navy blue jacket and a grey-and-blue plaid scarf, stands in an indoor environment decorated with dense green leaves. To his left, a large white snowy owl with grey spots sits calmly on a green padded perch. The man smiles and points toward the bird while looking at the camera. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a small, mottled brown and grey owl. A human hand enters the frame and gently strokes the owl's forehead with its knuckles. The owl's eyes are half-closed, suggesting a state of relaxation. Behind the owl, a blurred informational poster with Japanese text and images is visible. (3) The scene shifts to a pure white snowy owl resting on a similar green perch. A hand gently rubs the top of its head, and the owl responds by squinting its eyes and lifting its chin slightly. The background consists of vertical wooden panels and a poster featuring a barn owl. (4) The white owl is captured mid-yawn, opening its beak wide and stretching its facial feathers. A red cartoon shocked emoji with lines is edited above its head to emphasize the moment. The man stands to the right, looking at the owl with an expression of amused surprise. (5) In a medium shot, the man holds his arms against his chest in a hugging gesture, expressing the warmth of the animals. He is positioned next to the white owl's perch. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the textures of the bird's feathers and the man's jacket. (6) A close-up view of a dark brown owl with exceptionally large, black eyes staring directly forward. Its beak is small and yellowish. A hand strokes the soft feathers on its head from above. The background is a mix of dark foliage and soft, out-of-focus indoor lighting. (7) A woman wearing a beige hooded parka and a white knit beanie pets a barn owl that has a distinct heart-shaped white facial disc. The owl is perched on a natural-looking wooden branch. The background is a solid wall of artificial green ivy, creating a forest-like atmosphere. (8) The snowy owl on the tree-like structure rotates its head nearly 270 degrees, looking backwards and then towards the lens. The environment is decorated with bright orange and red artificial maple leaves, suggesting an autumn theme. A person in a white uniform is partially visible in the deep background. (9) A final sequence of close-ups shows various owls being petted, including a barn owl looking intently at the lens. The man's face appears in a circular video bubble at the bottom right corner as he concludes his narration. Colorful text overlays appear throughout the frame to provide additional information.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 京都貓頭鷹之森 摸到飽NT$200. (2) [Subtitle]: 工作人員會教導 使用手背輕輕觸摸. (3) [Subtitle]: 哈利波特嘿美的 分身在這裡. (4) [Variety]: 啊 打哈欠了. (5) [Subtitle]: 抱著牠們就覺得 是熱熱的暖爐. (6) [Subtitle]: 很絲滑、觸感很好. (7) [Subtitle]: 貓頭鷹觸感柔軟 羽毛非常蓬鬆和細膩. (8) [Variety]: 270度旋轉. (9) [Subtitle]: 數十種貓頭鷹 近距離接觸、拍照. (10) [Subtitle]: 環境乾淨整潔 沒有異味. (11) [Slogan]: 分享給要來日本玩的朋友. (12) [Subtitle]: 我可以摸一輩子 我要住在這邊一輩子. [Variety]: 拜託不要.
